description: Foundation + ingestion backend. Adds Step-4 dependencies, the llmProvider env key, migration 013 (material_chunk.subject_id + idx_material_chunk_material), the S3 put/get/delete seam (Finding 5), document parsers (PDF/DOCX/PPTX) and the pure chunker, the Titan embedding adapter behind the existing seam, the MaterialChunkRepository, CourseMaterialRepository extensions (setPageCount Finding 1, countCitingQuestions Finding 3, deleteById), the INGEST_MATERIAL factory handler, and the MaterialService/controller/routes with the non-null-subjectId upload rule (Finding 2) and subject-scope guard. Independent of FEAT-002/003 except that it provides the shared seams they build on; must come first. Mock stays default; no real AWS/Bedrock in tests.
steps: Add deps to backend/package.json and run `npm install` in backend/: @aws-sdk/client-bedrock-runtime@^3.917.0 (caret, matching the 5 sibling @aws-sdk deps) and pinned-exact pdfjs-dist@4.7.76, mammoth@1.8.0, jszip@3.10.1, multer@1.4.5-lts.1. uuid already present.

Add backend/db/migrations/013_material_chunk_subject.sql: idempotent `ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS subject_id INTEGER REFERENCES subject(subject_id)`, backfill from course_material, `CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_material_chunk_material ON material_chunk(material_id)`. NO SET NOT NULL (legacy NULLs; invariant owned at upload). Never edit applied migrations.

Extend backend/src/services/awsClients.js: import DeleteObjectCommand from @aws-sdk/client-s3 (Finding 5); add putObject/getObject(->Buffer)/deleteObject on BOTH mock and real branches. Mock uses an in-process Map (bucket/key->Buffer); getObject on missing key throws Error with code='NoSuchKey'; deleteObject removes. Real S3Client constructed with { endpoint: env.s3Endpoint || undefined, forcePathStyle: !!env.s3Endpoint }.

Create backend/src/ingest/chunkText.js: pure chunkSegments(segments, { targetWords:500, overlapWords:50 }). ~500-word chunks, ~50-word overlap carried into the next chunk of the SAME segment (overlap never crosses page/slide), each chunk carries location ('page N' PDF / 'slide N' PPTX / null DOCX) and a running chunk_no; short segment -> one chunk.

Create backend/src/ingest/parseDocument.js: one seam parse(mimeType, buffer) -> { segments:[{page,text}], pageCount }. PDF via pdfjs-dist/legacy/build/pdf.mjs (segment per page, pageCount=pages). DOCX via mammoth.extractRawText (single segment, page=null, pageCount=null). PPTX via jszip: enumerate ppt/slides/slide*.xml sorted by integer in filename, per slide concatenate all <a:t> descendants in document order then XML-entity-decode (named + numeric), page=slide number, pageCount=slide count.

Add backend/src/embedding/bedrockEmbeddingAdapter.js ({ embed(text)->number[1024] }, lazy BedrockRuntimeClient, InvokeModel modelId=env.bedrockEmbedModelId||'amazon.titan-embed-text-v2:0', body {inputText,dimensions:1024,normalize:true}, validate length 1024). Extend createEmbeddingAdapter in embeddingAdapter.js: `if (env.awsMockMode) return mock;` then switch bedrock|titan -> bedrock, else mock.

Extend backend/src/repositories/courseMaterialRepository.js: setPageCount(id,pageCount,client) [Finding 1], countCitingQuestions(materialId,client) [Finding 3 SQL: SELECT COUNT(*)::int AS n FROM question_source_ref qsr JOIN material_chunk mc ON mc.material_chunk_id=qsr.chunk_id WHERE mc.material_id=$1 -- INNER JOIN ignores NULL chunk_id], deleteById(materialId,client). Each accepts an optional tx client defaulting to this.db.

Create backend/src/repositories/materialChunkRepository.js (constructor(db)): insertMany(materialId,subjectId,chunks,client) writing subject_id on every row and serializing embeddings via toVectorLiteral imported from questionRepository.js; deleteByMaterial(materialId,client); findNearestForTopic({materialIds,queryEmbedding,limit}) using per-material ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY material_id ORDER BY embedding <=> $query) WHERE material_id = ANY($1), keep rn<=ceil(limit/numMaterials), re-rank globally, truncate; returns {material_chunk_id,material_id,location,content}.

Replace the INGEST_MATERIAL stub in backend/src/jobs/handlers.js with makeIngestMaterialHandler({db,courseMaterialRepository,materialChunkRepository,embeddingAdapter,awsClients,parse,logger}): load (missing->throw; READY->return); capture subjectId=material.subject_id; set PROCESSING; getObject; parse; text-layer check MIN_EXTRACTED_CHARS=20 -> FAILED 'needs a text layer' no-throw; chunkSegments; embed sequentially; then ONE db.withTransaction: deleteByMaterial(tx)->insertMany(materialId,subjectId,chunks,tx)->setPageCount(materialId,pageCount,tx)->updateStatus(materialId,'READY',null). Parse-throw->FAILED no-throw; S3/embed error->throw. Extend registerDefaultHandlers(queue,deps) to build ingest (and later generation) handlers only when deps.db && deps.db.withTransaction, else keep no-op stubs.

Create backend/src/services/materialService.js: deps {courseMaterialRepository,subjectRepository,topicRepository,awsClients,enqueueJob,env,logger}. Private assertSubjectInScope(user,subjectId) (ADMIN bypass else listSubjectIdsForLecturer -> 403). upload: validate subjectId present/integer/>0 -> 400 BEFORE any S3/DB write [Finding 2]; file required (400); MIME/ext PDF/DOCX/PPTX else 400 UNSUPPORTED_TYPE; size via multer 413 FILE_TOO_LARGE; optional topicId belongs-to-subject else 400 / unknown 404 TOPIC_NOT_FOUND; assertSubjectInScope 403; S3 key materials/{subjectId}/{uuid}/{name}, putObject (502 STORAGE_ERROR, no DB write), create({...pageCount:null,status:'UPLOADED',uploadedBy}), enqueueJob('INGEST_MATERIAL',{materialId}). list: validate+scope subjectId then listBySubject. delete: load (404)->scope from row (403)->countCitingQuestions>0 -> 409 MATERIAL_IN_USE stop -> else deleteObject best-effort (swallow NoSuchKey) -> deleteById.

Create backend/src/controllers/materialController.js (upload/list/remove; map multer LIMIT_FILE_SIZE -> 413 FILE_TOO_LARGE) and backend/src/routes/materialRoutes.js (requireAuth + requireRole('LECTURER') on all; POST uses multer memoryStorage single('file') limits.fileSize=50MB). In backend/src/app.js construct the repos/service/controller, inject enqueueJob:(t,p)=>backgroundJobRepository.enqueue(t,p), mount '/materials'.

Add unit tests: backend/test/chunkTextService.test.js, backend/test/parseDocumentService.test.js (two-slide PPTX fixture: slide 10 sorts after slide 2, entities decode), backend/test/embeddingAdapterService.test.js (factory honors awsMockMode/provider, mock determinism, no network), backend/test/ingestMaterialService.test.js (PROCESSING->READY; no-text-layer->FAILED no-throw; parse error->FAILED no-throw; S3/embed error->throw; insertMany receives material.subject_id; setPageCount called with parser pageCount), backend/test/materialService.test.js (upload type/size/scope validation via fakes, subjectId<=0 -> 400 before any write, S3 put via fake, enqueueJob spy ('INGEST_MATERIAL',{materialId}), delete 409 when countCitingQuestions>0 and deleteObject NOT called, delete 403 out-of-scope, 404 missing).
acceptance_criteria: `cd backend && npm install` resolves with the five new deps at the stated versions.
`cd backend && npm test` passes including the five new *Service.test.js suites.
`cd backend && npm run test:e2e` stays green offline (DB-backed suites self-skip).
subjectId absent/non-integer/<=0 returns 400 VALIDATION_ERROR before any S3 put or DB insert (asserted in materialService.test.js).
The ingest handler persists page_count (setPageCount) and threads material.subject_id into insertMany (asserted in ingestMaterialService.test.js).
awsClients mock put/get/delete round-trips and get-after-delete throws code 'NoSuchKey'.
findings:
COMPLETED. Exact seams later features build on:

[awsClients] createAwsClients(env) now exposes on BOTH mock+real branches: putObject({bucket,key,body,contentType}) -> {bucket,key}; getObject({bucket,key}) -> Buffer (mock throws Error with .code='NoSuchKey' on a missing key); deleteObject({bucket,key}). Real S3Client built with { region, endpoint: env.s3Endpoint||undefined, forcePathStyle: !!env.s3Endpoint }. DeleteObjectCommand imported (Finding 5). Existing getUploadUrl/invokeAudioWorkflow/sessionStore unchanged. The materials bucket is env.materialsBucket (default 'local-materials-bucket').

[parse seam] require('../ingest/parseDocument') exports: parse(mimeType, buffer) -> { segments: [{page:number|null, text:string}], pageCount:number|null } (async; throws Error statusCode=400 code='UNSUPPORTED_TYPE' for other MIME; PDF via dynamic import of 'pdfjs-dist/legacy/build/pdf.mjs' one segment/page, DOCX one segment page=null pageCount=null, PPTX one segment/slide sorted numerically). Also exports decodeXmlEntities(text) and the MIME constants PDF_MIME, DOCX_MIME, PPTX_MIME.

[chunker] require('../ingest/chunkText') exports chunkSegments(segments, { targetWords=500, overlapWords=50, locationKind='page'|'slide' }) -> [{ chunk_no, location, content }]. Pure, no deps. location is `${locationKind} ${page}` or null; chunk_no runs document-wide; overlap never crosses a segment.

[embedding] require('../embedding/embeddingAdapter').createEmbeddingAdapter(env): if env.awsMockMode returns the mock FIRST; else embeddingProvider 'bedrock'|'titan' -> BedrockEmbeddingAdapter else mock. require('../embedding/bedrockEmbeddingAdapter') exports BedrockEmbeddingAdapter (class, { env }) / createBedrockEmbeddingAdapter / EMBEDDING_DIMS=1024 / DEFAULT_MODEL_ID='amazon.titan-embed-text-v2:0'. embed(text)->number[1024], lazy BedrockRuntimeClient, InvokeModelCommand, body {inputText,dimensions:1024,normalize:true}, reads JSON .embedding. Mock seam unchanged.

[repos] courseMaterialRepository: added setPageCount(id,pageCount,client=this.db) [Finding 1], countCitingQuestions(materialId,client=this.db) [Finding 3 INNER JOIN], deleteById(materialId,client=this.db); updateStatus now also takes an optional (id,status,error,client=this.db). materialChunkRepository.js (class MaterialChunkRepository, constructor(db)) exports insertMany(materialId,subjectId,chunks,client=this.db) (writes subject_id per row, serializes embedding via toVectorLiteral from questionRepository), deleteByMaterial(materialId,client=this.db) -> count, findNearestForTopic({materialIds,queryEmbedding,limit},client=this.db) -> [{material_chunk_id,material_id,location,content}] (per-material ROW_NUMBER partition, global re-rank, truncate). toVectorLiteral is exported from questionRepository.js.

[jobs] handlers.js exports makeIngestMaterialHandler({db,courseMaterialRepository,materialChunkRepository,embeddingAdapter,awsClients,parse,env,logger}) and MIN_EXTRACTED_CHARS=20. registerDefaultHandlers(queue, deps) builds the real INGEST_MATERIAL handler ONLY when deps.db && typeof deps.db.withTransaction==='function' AND the ingest deps are present, else no-op stub; GENERATE_QUESTIONS/GRADE_INTERVIEW still stubs for later features to replace. app.jobContext = { db, courseMaterialRepository, materialChunkRepository, embeddingAdapter, awsClients, parse, env } is set in app.js and spread into registerDefaultHandlers in server.js's DB branch (alongside logger+emailService).

[wiring] app.js constructs CourseMaterialRepository, MaterialChunkRepository, MaterialService, MaterialController; enqueueJob = overrides.enqueueJob || ((t,p)=>backgroundJobRepository.enqueue(t,p)); mounts createMaterialRouter at '/materials' with requireAuth+requireRole('LECTURER'). All overridable via createApp overrides keys: courseMaterialRepository, materialChunkRepository, materialService, materialController, enqueueJob.

[service] MaterialService deps {courseMaterialRepository,subjectRepository,topicRepository,awsClients,enqueueJob,env,logger}. upload({user,subjectId,topicId,file}) validates subjectId>0 BEFORE any write (Finding 2, 400 VALIDATION_ERROR), file required, MIME/ext PDF/DOCX/PPTX else 400 UNSUPPORTED_TYPE, optional topic belongs-to-subject (404 TOPIC_NOT_FOUND / 400), _assertSubjectInScope (ADMIN bypass, else listSubjectIdsForLecturer -> 403 FORBIDDEN), S3 key materials/{subjectId}/{uuid}/{title}, putObject (502 STORAGE_ERROR), create status 'UPLOADED', enqueueJob('INGEST_MATERIAL',{materialId}). list({user,subjectId}). delete({user,materialId}): 404 -> scope 403 -> countCitingQuestions>0 => 409 MATERIAL_IN_USE (deleteObject NOT called) -> else best-effort deleteObject (swallows .code==='NoSuchKey') -> deleteById.

[routes] createMaterialRouter(controller,{requireAuth,requireRole}) also exports MAX_FILE_BYTES=52428800; POST '/' uses multer memoryStorage single('file'), LIMIT_FILE_SIZE mapped to 413 FILE_TOO_LARGE.

[migration] 013_material_chunk_subject.sql adds material_chunk.subject_id (nullable FK) + idx_material_chunk_material; 014 is the next free number.

[env] env.llmProvider added (default 'mock') for FEAT generation work.

[deps] added @aws-sdk/client-bedrock-runtime@^3.917.0, pdfjs-dist@4.7.76, mammoth@1.8.0, jszip@3.10.1, multer@1.4.5-lts.1.

Verification: npm install OK; npm test 135 pass (incl. 5 new suites); npm run test:e2e 78 pass / 7 skipped (DB suites self-skip offline).
